newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - P&G 97,98 earnings raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - P&G 97,98 earnings raised.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers analyst Carol Warner said in a Jan 31 report that she raised Procter & Gamble's fiscal year 1997 estimate to $4.85 per share from $4.78 per share and the company's 1998 estimate to $5.45 per share from $5.35 per share.
-- said the company's second-quarter earnings, posted on Jan 28, increased 14 percent to $1.35 per share. Sales growth was only 0.6 percent but was helped by "significant" gross margin improvements.
-- "Although we were disappointed by the top line, margin expansion continues to exceed our estimates," Warner said.
